name: Forward Cordlength
description: Snap the throwing arm out straight and let the weighted point fly at the target's chest.

name: Easing Snapback
description: Draw the loose cord into the palm while stepping in so the weight never drags on the ground.

name: Planted Dartblade
description: Stretch the cord taut across the forearm to stop a swung stick or short blade.

name: Thrumstrike
description: Swing the weight low along the ground so it raps the opponent's ankle bone as they step.

name: Thrumwedge
description: A single loop of cord is flicked over the opponent's wrist and pulled tight so the hand cannot reach cleanly.

name: Kind Cordknot
description: Stand with the cord hanging slack and read the opponent's shoulders for the first twitch of a strike.

name: Hard Dartneck
description: Whirl the dart in a flat circle above the head, then bring it down on the opponent's shoulder.

name: Level Reelin
description: From the hip a wide arc of the weight lands against the opponent's near ribs.

name: Kept Tailring
description: Rolling the wrist makes the cord trace a figure eight that bats incoming blows away from the body.

name: Tinepace
description: Plant one heel, turn the body half round, and let the cord follow to a fresh angle of attack.

name: Spoolstrike
description: A short snap of the wrist drives the point into the soft spot beneath the opponent's collarbone.

name: Reelincowl
description: Crack the cord across the back of a hand that holds a weapon so the grip loosens.

name: Quiet Flickhand
description: Back away in short steps while hauling the dart in hand over hand and never turning the back.

name: Sharp Retrieve
description: After letting the weight swing loosely back and forth, release the forward swing into the opponent's thigh.

name: Upward Whipout
description: The weight lifts from below in a rising arc to catch the opponent beneath the chin or elbow.

name: Ringend Wedge
description: Sweep the outstretched cord sideways to brush a thrusting point off its line.

name: Reelinamble
description: Turning a quarter circle on the ball of the foot clears the cord for the next swing.

name: Even Cordloop
description: Keep the weight swinging in a steady easy beat and feel the pull on the cord to judge reach.

name: Flat Loopcast
description: Uncoil a palm-held loop in one motion so the dart leaves the hand on a clean straight pull.

name: Tight Cordloop
description: Wrapping the cord twice about the forearm makes a padded bar against a swung cudgel.

name: Towing Whipout
description: Flick the point toward the opponent's eyes so they flinch and lose the count of their own attack.

name: Level Cordwinder
description: Throw the dart past the target, then snap the cord back so the weight clips the opponent from behind.

name: Quiet Tailring
description: Lean from the hips out of a swing's path while the cord slides through the guiding hand.

name: Pluckwedge
description: The cord's tail hooks behind the opponent's leg and a tug buckles the knee.

name: Forward Spiralcast
description: Wind a short turn of cord across the knuckles and punch while the weight swings free behind the fist.

name: Thrumreview
description: Pace out the cord's length against a standing opponent until the distance for a throw is known by feel.

name: Descending Ringend
description: Haul the thrown dart back hand over hand so it drags across the target on its return.

name: Thrumlid
description: Let the weight fall behind a step, then haul it forward again to keep the opponent guessing.

name: Pluckdash
description: Loop the cord around a post or branch so the dart comes back at the opponent from the side.

name: Pulling Cordknot
description: Pull the cord quickly through a grasping hand so the burn forces the grab to open.

name: Wide Retrieve
description: Throw, haul and catch the dart in one flowing chain so the next throw leaves with no pause.

name: Thrumstay
description: Set both feet wide and lean back against the cord to stand firm against a pulling opponent.

name: Snapback Bump
description: Run a thread of qi down the cord so the dart flies true and holds its line to the target.

name: Reelinhit
description: Drive the point forward the length of an arm with the cord held tight behind it.

name: Holding Cordlength
description: A pulse of qi stiffens the cord across the body so it stops a thrown stone or short blade.

name: Quiet Reelin
description: Slide forward on a half-coiled cord, qi drawing the weight along behind so the distance closes quietly.

name: Gnawing Cordwinder
description: Whip the loosened cord out low so its weight lashes the opponent's shin.

name: Spoolstay
description: Drop a ring of cord over a thrown limb and pull, qi tightening the loop at the last moment.

name: Tending Dartneck
description: Count breaths while the qi thread feels the dart's weight, fixing the throw before the arm moves.

name: Pulling Loopcast
description: The cord is thrown round the opponent's elbow and cinched so the arm cannot extend.

name: Turning Retrieve
description: Spiral the cord up a spear or staff shaft and twist to wrench the weapon out of line.

name: Sharp Darttip
description: Shake a wrapped cord loose in one pull and let the freed weight whip into the opponent's guard.

name: Pluckcowl
description: Parry a blade with the cord-wrapped forearm and let the loops carry the edge past the body.

name: Shifting Spiralcast
description: Step in as the wrap tightens so the opponent's tugging back only pulls them toward the user.

name: Firm Dartblade
description: Cast the weighted end straight ahead with a push of qi from the back foot through the arm.

name: Downward Snapback
description: Swing the weight in a flat side arc at the height of the opponent's hip.

name: Resting Dartblade
description: Spin the cord before the body in a steady disk so thrown darts and stones scatter off it.

name: Nabbing Darttip
description: Let the weight fall past the opponent's ankle and draw the loop closed behind it.

name: Upward Darttip
description: As the weight returns from a missed cast it is snapped round into the ribs.

name: Backward Flickhand
description: Back off to the full length of the cord with the weight trailing to discourage pursuit.

name: Tinelid
description: Shoot the point at the opponent's face and pull it back short, drawing the guard up.

name: Pluckgauge
description: Feel through the cord whether a snared opponent is slack or straining and answer accordingly.

name: Low Cordloop
description: Qi locks the cord straight like a short rod and the point pokes into a gap in the guard.

name: Pluckpause
description: Let qi soften the cord so it wraps around a limb, then stiffen it to hold.

name: Tinestay
description: Stiffen a short stretch of the cord into a bar held across the chest against a heavy cut.

name: Square Flickhand
description: Soft cord whips out to the limit of its length and snaps taut at the instant of contact.

name: Easing Dartneck
description: Hook the weight on a fixed point and let a pulse of qi haul the body sideways.

name: Steady Ringend
description: Read the pull of a gripped cord through the thread of qi to learn how the opponent shifts.

name: Spoolbump
description: Throw the dart at the far end of the long tail so it reaches a foe beyond sword length.

name: Firm Cordlength
description: Whirl the long tail overhead and let the dart fall steeply onto the opponent's crown or shoulder.

name: Planted Tailring
description: Keep the long tail circling around the body so blows are knocked aside before they land.

name: Pluckhop
description: Sidestep with the tail trailing so the opponent follows into the dart's path.

name: Pulling Whipout
description: Fold the long tail double over a wrist or a haft and pull the loop shut.

name: Hard Loopcast
description: Crack the very end of the tail against the shin where the long reach has the most leverage.

name: Cordknot Note
description: Glance along the tail to measure how far the opponent stands from the dart's reach.
